relations.myth: Lucan's grouping of blood-propitiated Gaulish gods
relations.note: Lucan names Teutates and Taranis together without narrating an interaction.

relations.myth: Lucan's grouping of blood-propitiated Gaulish gods
relations.note: Lucan names Esus and Taranis together without narrating an interaction.
Roman inscriptions and Lucan scholia identify Taranic divine forms with Jupiter.
One medieval scholion equates Taranis with Dis Pater, unsupported by inscriptions.
Lucan compares Taranis's cruel altar with hers; the deities never meet.
